name: BSP_FrontEndFrame_SelectLayoutSet
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_title_init, read-only analysis. __thiscall, ECX = the 0x164 singleton at 00E18D80, two stack arguments (int set, char commit), RET 8 inferred from the call site at 004c9b85 (no caller-side ADD ESP), not read from the epilogue. Holds three parallel handle arrays with matching .rdata name tables: backdrop this+0Ch / names 00E08500 / 13 slots / set stride 34h; panel this+110h / names 00E08604 / 2 slots / set stride 8; title this+138h / names 00E0862C / 2 slots / set stride 8. Returns at once when set equals this+160h. With commit set it first walks all three arrays slot-major and releases every handle belonging to another set (BSP_GuiManager_GetOrCreate then 00aa31f0 when the word at layout+4h is exactly 1, otherwise InterlockedDecrement(layout+4h) with the layout virtual +0h at zero), then fills the requested set's null slots with BSP_GuiManager_GetOrCreate then 00aa5840(&name, 1, 1), then stores this+160h = set. Tables: set 0 and 1 FE_frame + FE_frame_title, set 2 adds FE_options_bg (backdrop 6) and FE_main (backdrop 12), set 3 GUI_pause + GUI_pause_title, set 4 empty. GGame::OnInitTitle calls it with (0, 1), so the title bring-up loads exactly FE_frame and FE_frame_title through this path. Four callers: 004c9a70, 004c9ca0, 004dfb70, BSP_LoadingScreen_Begin. docs/GAME_TITLE_INIT.md | Run-time evidence from bsp_game.exe milestone 2c (packet cc_exe_2c), `--frames 120 --press-start-frame 30` against the installed game; see docs/GAME_EXECUTABLE.md. Set 0 loads exactly FE_frame and FE_frame_title; both stay on screen through the press-start handover because they belong to the 0x164 layout singleton and not to a registry screen. | Packet cc_exe_2j (bsp_game.exe milestone 2j), ABI correction plus run-time evidence. The routine is __thiscall(layouts, int set, int commit), RET 8: the set is [ESP+34h] read at 00518268 and compared with [ECX+160h] at 00518273. At both call sites the two pushes that precede the CALL belong to 00518250, not to 004C1AC0, which takes no arguments and only supplies ECX. The mission load's row at 004E04E4 is therefore (set 3, commit 0) and BSP_Game_ApplyInGameInterface's at 004C9DFB is (set 3, commit 1). In bsp_game.exe the committing call releases sets 0, 1, 2 and 4's backdrop, panel and title layouts and makes 3 active, which takes FE_frame and FE_frame_title off the mission picture; the sprite bridge drops from 70 quads to 57. docs/GAME_EXECUTABLE.md milestone 2j.

name: BSP_PlanePilotView_BuildPlayerCommand
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_pilot_controls, read-only analysis. __fastcall(view), Ghidra body 00519520-00519823, view+1Ch is the unit and view+24h caches the throttle. The local pilot's command producer and the only per-frame writer of the pilot command block: zeroes six stack dwords at 00519569-00519575, fills the pitch slot from the vertical aim error against unit+C64h and the horizontal slot from the azimuth error against unit+C68h (both through 00438B10 BSP_Math_SubtractWrappedAngle on 004BEC00 BSP_InputManager_GetSingleton fields +2094h and +2064h), interpolates the throttle, and at 00519818 pushes the block through 007B8C90 only when 00927F30 BSP_UnitInstance_IsLocalPlayerRole(1) is true. The roll slot is never assigned. caller: unestablished, no xref and no vtable entry for the bytes 20 95 51 00. docs/PILOT_CONTROLS.md | Packet cc2_pilot_command_path closes the caller and corrects the signature. IT IS __thiscall(view, float dt), RET 4, not (view): prologue SUB ESP,28h/PUSH ESI/MOV ESI,ECX, epilogue RET 4 at 00519821, and the caller pushes the float at 00519CED FLD [ESP+24h]/00519CF1 PUSH ECX/00519CF4 FSTP [ESP]. THE CALLER IS 00519BB0 (BSP_HudPilotScreen_Update, the pilot HUD screen's virtual slot 00CEC578+38h, no Ghidra function, raw body 00519BB0-00519D3D) at call site 00519CF7 - the only E8 displacement in the image that lands here. 00519BB0 reaches it only when bytes [00E188A8]+61Fh and +620h are clear and 007BB9A0(view+1Ch) is true; the screen writes the GUI field role_Text (00CEC768) to ingame.pilotplayer or ingame.pilotai from 00927F30(unit, 1) just before. docs/PILOT_COMMAND_PATH.md

name: BSP_BriefingScreen_ActivatePlay
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __fastcall(this), RET 4. Reads the active widget through 00A9CA00 and matches it against the three difficulty widgets at +9Ch, +0A0h and +0A4h, writing the matching index 0, 1 or 2 into both game+6ACh and game+6B0h. Clears +90h, calls virtual +34h and +60h(0) on +98h and +60h(1) on +6Ch and +124h, clears the byte at [+124h]+77h, rebuilds the help line with 0051B450(0, 0) and pumps the input manager. A second arm at 0051B866 calls 00439020, the mission-start request pair; Ghidra stops its stored body there, so the selector between the arms is visible only in the listing. See docs/MISSION_TREE_BRIEFING_SCREENS.md. | Correction (packet cc_mission_briefing): this routine is unreferenced. A linear E8/E9 scan of .text finds no relative CALL or JMP into 0051B7B0..0051B88C, and the bytes B0 B7 51 00 occur nowhere in the file, so no vtable, table or immediate holds its address; the same scan reproduces the three known call sites of 00439020 and of 0051B450. It is compiled in and uncalled. The reachable play action is 005922F0 on the main-menu screen. Its selector, previously said to be outside Ghidra's stored body, is a stack argument: CMP byte ptr [ESP+0Ch],BL at 0051B857 behind PUSH EBX / PUSH ESI, so the ABI is __thiscall void(BriefingScreen* this, bool start_now), RET 4 at 0051B88A; zero rebuilds the help line through 0051B450(0,0), non-zero calls 00439020. Ghidra drops the 0051B866 block as unreachable because its stored prototype has no stack parameter.
